# Poly Haven Materials

All selected texture sets were downloaded from Poly Haven on 2026-11-22.
Poly Haven publishes these assets under Creative Commons Zero 1.0 Universal
(CC0): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Commercial use, modification, and redistribution are allowed. Attribution is
not required, but the source and authors are retained in the project credit.

For each set, the project downloaded the 2K JPEG diffuse, normal, roughness,
and ARM maps. Unity-ready masks are generated under `Assets/Demo02/Art`; the
downloaded maps remain unchanged under `Assets/ThirdParty/PolyHaven`.
